leads.subject: Document intelligence that agents can trust
leads.body:
Hi Unsiloed team,

Your founding backend role is about making vision-first document extraction reliable enough for other systems to build on. That problem feels familiar: while building a RAG pipeline, I learned that chunking choices and evaluation can matter more than swapping models.

At Stride AI, I shipped backend APIs and full-stack features with tests, and I like owning failure paths rather than just the happy-path demo. I'm based in India and saw that you sponsor visas for the San Francisco role.

Could I show you a small piece of relevant backend work and see whether it fits what you're building?

Devansh

GitHub: https://github.com/8dazo

leads.subject: Integrations behind Fenrock's bank agents
leads.body:
Hi Charu,

Fenrock's approach of overlaying existing bank systems instead of replacing them caught my attention. The integration boundary seems like the hard part: permissions, auditability, and messy operational workflows.

At Stride AI, I built a shared authentication service across apps and shipped backend APIs through production tests. I've also built agent tooling, but what I enjoy most is making a useful workflow dependable end to end.

I saw the founding full-stack role offers visa sponsorship. I'm based in India and open to relocating. Would it be useful to share a short walkthrough of the authentication work?

Devansh
